text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, the one on the left is the Joker!
Heheh, it's way too obvious from your face, Chiyo-chan~!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! And I was being so careful, too~!
Uuugh... I definitely won't mess up next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because they were far too honest, they ended up unable to win a single match...
